en: An analysis reached your phone, with a plan.
Every analysis now ends with what becomes of its plan.
Waiting for your Go. Run by the policies. Or recorded only.
And it names the line that decided: here, a policy that pins this container to observe.
When a plan waits for you, an operator can now answer in the console as well.
Only if the executor's own rules allow it: the core cannot turn that on by itself.
It is the same answer as on your phone.
The first one counts, the phone is told, and the log keeps your name.
Some sources never send the recovery, so an incident can stay open for days.
One that was not seen for two days is now marked quiet.
Re-check asks the source what the alert is right now.
Back to normal, and the incident resolves the usual way.
Otherwise, close it by hand, with one line of why. If it fires again, it opens again.
Triage reads a postmortem only once a person has reviewed it.
Mark it reviewed, edit it, or have the model write a missing prose again.
Every change is in the record, with your name.
And the calls in between are yours, from the phone or the console.
